verdict.rationale: The only story-relevant evidence is a JumpCloud integration doc (JumpCloud is a directory/MDM platform) plus generic claims of continuous monitoring and evidence collection, so an MDM-based path is plausible but undocumented in the pack. Nothing shows per-employee device checks. missing for 10: a documented Sprinto endpoint agent, per-employee workstation compliance tracking, disk encryption checks, screen lock checks, password manager checks, details of what the JumpCloud/MDM integration actually monitors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
